definitions.call: one generated child program (one completion); EAP/BINT count only code-writing calls, their stage-1 GPU time is charged to their GPU-seconds
definitions.correct: valid (AST pre-screen) AND stage 1 (8 quick cases) AND stage 2 (full hidden suite) AND stage 3 (10 seeded max-size stress inputs vs the fastest reference)
definitions.OOC_screen: correct AND (final label == 'other' OR nearest-known Jaccard s < s*_task), s*_task = 5th percentile of nearest-known similarities of correct forced catalogue programs (label == Y) and the references
definitions.distinct: within an arm in call order: identical normalised-token hash merges, then Jaccard >= 0.9 to an earlier program collapses into it
definitions.idea_cluster: pooled over arms, within each cell (runtime label, DS-signature): single-linkage components at Jaccard >= 0.5; after adjudication clusters whose judges named the same algorithm merge
definitions.level_b: distinct adjudicated KNOWN OUTSIDE CATALOGUE + NOVEL
definitions.cell: (runtime label, DS-signature = first 3 of heap, deque_or_queue, sort, bisect, recursion, dict_or_counter, set, matrix_2d, stack_list, bitops, random, custom_class)
definitions.novelty: nu = 1 - s, s = max token-4-gram Jaccard to corpus + catalogue references (self-match of a seed excluded)

tests.primary: exact conditional binomial test of two Poisson rates; LB95 from the one-sided Clopper-Pearson bound; two-sided 95% CI; Holm across tasks
tests.verdict: STRONG LB95>=10; MET R_hat>=10 & LB95>1; UNRESOLVED R_hat>=10 & LB95<=1; NOT MET R_hat<10; NOT ESTIMABLE X_S=X_K=0; overall MET if >=2 tasks MET/STRONG
tests.matched_effort: rarefaction/Chao-1 extrapolation of idea-cluster richness of i.i.d. arms to N_S (trusted to 2x N)
tests.robustness: island-cluster bootstrap (2,000 reps) of S's rate; arm-shuffle placebo; seeds-as-children check
